title: Lab - JSONPath
description: Answer questions about the cluster with one query each.
scenario: Answer questions about the cluster with one query each. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Node names
tasks.instructions: Print all node names, one per line.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Custom columns
tasks.instructions: Print node name and CPU capacity as two columns.
